# Test Report (Retest R1): PR #5839 feat: per-user throttle tier and signup bot checks **Branch:** `feat/shadow-throttle-tier` → `main` **Author:** jarlacut **Preview:** https://app.pr5839.preview.bike4mind.com **Build under test:** head `11ae4cf58` · preview **deploy SUCCESS** (`/api/health` deployedRevision = head) · CI **SUCCESS** (33 pass, 8 skipping) **Previous run:** R0 PASS on `00ddc627b` (2026-10-28), see `../B4M-5839-test-results.md` **Date:** 2026-10-28 ## Overall result: ✅ PASS **What changed since R0:** `11ae4cf58` is a merge of `origin/main` into the branch. It adds no PR commits but brings 23 main commits that touch the same surfaces: login Turnstile retry (#5946), disposable-domain intel (#5814), no-card unlock (#5871), the admin user card (#5943) and the admin settings save model (#5920). I re-ran the full guide on the new build with fresh users. **Step 4 is still ⚠️ BLOCKED on previews by design.** `otc/send` skips signup signals when `isE2EEnabled()`, so a honeypot signup cannot become shadowed on a preview. The client side was re-verified: `formExtra:"x"` plus a form token are sent, and the response and signup are identical. Every other step passed again, so the result is 11 of 13 guide steps PASS (step 3 is the setup action for step 4) plus the Register regression. **No bugs found in this PR.** Not verified, as in R0: the server `llm-usage-settled` log in step 10. The substitution evidence is the credit cost.
Accounts used | Account | Role | Used for | |---|---|---| | `qa-admin-e2e@test.com` | Admin | Shadow tier set/clear (Users -> Full view), audit log, settings, credit set for comparison | | `qa-pr5839-r1s1-e2e@test.com` (new, login-page signup) | Normal (Customer) | Step 1; shadowed user for steps 5-13 | | `qa-pr5839-r1s3-e2e@test.com` (new, honeypot signup) | Normal (Customer) | Step 3; unshadowed comparison user | | `qa-pr5839-r1reg-e2e@test.com` (new, Register page) | Normal | Regression: Register-page signup | Login: E2E one-time-code flow (8-digit codes). Each user ran in its own browser context.
Results by step (1-13) Status emoji: ✅ PASS · ❌ FAIL · ⚠️ BLOCKED · ⚪ N/A · ➖ NOT TESTED. ### ✅ Step 1 - Normal-pace OTC signup - The honeypot is unchanged: `input[name=hp_ref_x]`, `tabIndex -1`, `autocomplete=off`, x=-10000, inside `aria-hidden=true`. I typed at about 90 ms per key; signup completed to `/new`. - On the **first** page load after the redeploy, `otc/send` went out **without `formToken`** (`{"email":..., "formExtra":""}`), though both form-token fetches were issued. Three later fresh page loads all sent the token (each fetch 200), and so did every other signup in this run. See Observations. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-01-signup-normal-complete.png` ### ✅ Step 2 - New user is not shadowed - Admin -> Users -> search `qa-pr5839-r1` -> view mode **Full** -> Admin Actions: "Shadow tier" is unchecked for `qapr5839r1s1`. The API shows no `throttle` and no `riskSignals`. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-02-04-admin-full-view-shadow-unchecked.png` (IPs masked) ### ✅ Step 3 - Honeypot filled via the guide's console snippet - `otc/send` body carried a form token and `"formExtra":"x"`. The code screen and signup were identical, landing on `/new`. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-03-honeypot-filled-code-screen.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-03b-honeypot-signup-complete.png` ### ⚠️ Step 4 - Honeypot user shadowed - BLOCKED (environment) - As expected on a preview: `qapr5839r1s3` is unchecked and has no `throttle`, `riskSignals` or audit row. `collectSignupSignals` returns `[]` under `isE2EEnabled()`. Needs the non-E2E stage named in the guide. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-02-04-admin-full-view-shadow-unchecked.png` ### ✅ Step 5 - Admin sets Shadow tier with a reason - With the box checked and the reason empty, **Update is disabled**. Reason `QA PR5839 R1 shadow tier test` -> Update -> `PUT /api/users//update` **200**, toast "Profile updated successfully", info "Tier shadow, source admin, changed 2026-10-28." - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-06a-empty-reason-update-disabled.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-05-shadow-checked-reason-filled.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-06b-shadow-saved-info.png` ### ✅ Step 6 - One audit entry, no-op writes nothing, empty reason 400 - Exactly one `user.throttle_tier.changed` entry (severity critical), before `none` -> after `shadow`. - No-change re-PUT (API, because the Update button hides once the form is clean) -> 200, still one entry. - Reason `""` -> **400** "A reason of at least 5 characters is required"; `"abc"` -> 400. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-06c-audit-log-throttle-entry.png` ### ✅ Step 7-8 - 200, 200, 200, then 429 - Shadowed user, `GET /api/v1/projects` x5: **200, 200, 200, 429 (Retry-After 59), 429 (58)**, body `TooManyRequestsError` / "Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 59 seconds." - Normal user `qapr5839r1s3`: 10 x 200, then the identical 429 shape (`Retry-After 55`). - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-07-08-shadow-rpm-429.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-08b-normal-user-429-comparison.png` ### ✅ Step 9-10 - Premium model kept client-side, silent substitution - With **Claude Sonnet 5** selected, both `/api/ai/llm` requests carried `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`. The reply was normal and the UI still showed Claude Sonnet 5. - "Which model are you?" -> "I am Claude Sonnet 5 (model id global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5)." - Cost: shadowed turns **2 credits each** (10000 -> 9998 -> 9996). The same prompt from the normal user cost **29 credits**, and the R1 user's own Sonnet turn after clearing cost **32**. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-09-shadow-chat-hello.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-10-shadow-which-model.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-10b-normal-user-sonnet-cost-comparison.png` ### ✅ Step 11-12 - Daily token cap -> native insufficient-credits error - `shadowTierDailyTokenCap` 20000 -> **1000**, saved at 03:24:23 UTC. Since main's #5920 this goes through the page-level save bar ("1 unsaved change", `admin-save-confirm-btn`) rather than a per-setting Save. My first click on Save didn't register, and a second click saved it (`PUT /api/settings/update` 200, row = 1000). - First shadowed turn after the 5-minute settings cache (03:29:52): **"You're out of credits. This request needs about 322 credits, but only 0 are available. Add credits to keep going."** + Top up / Get Pro. The real balance was 9,996. - Reference, a real user at 10 credits: **"You're out of credits. This request needs about 675 credits, but only 10 are available. Add credits to keep going."** + Top up / Get Pro. Same message and buttons. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-11a-daily-token-cap-save-bar.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-11-daily-token-cap-1000.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-12-shadow-daily-cap-error.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-12b-free-user-low-credits-reference.png` ### ✅ Step 13 - Clear the tier -> normal limits on the next request - Unchecked, reason `QA PR5839 R1 clear shadow tier` -> 200, toast. Audit: one new entry, `shadow` -> `none` (two entries total for this user). - About 6 s later: `GET /api/v1/projects` x6 -> **all 200**. A chat turn answered at real Sonnet pricing (**32 credits**) with no cap error. - **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-13a-uncheck-shadow-reason.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-13b-after-clear-normal-limits.png` ### Regression checks - ✅ **Register page:** honeypot present, `otc/send` with form token + `formExtra:""`, Create Account -> `/new`. **Evidence:** `B4M-5839-R1-REG-register-form.png`, `B4M-5839-R1-REG-register-signup-complete.png` - ✅ **Login-page signup:** steps 1 and 3. - ✅ **Normal user rate limit (10/min) and Sonnet billing unchanged.** - ✅ **Self view hides `throttle` / `riskSignals`.** - ➖ **API-key rate-limit headers:** NOT TESTED (no key minted). - ⚠️ **OAuth login:** BLOCKED (no real OAuth credentials on previews).
Findings **Bugs in this PR** None. **Pre-existing issues (not caused by this PR)** None. **Observations** - **One `otc/send` without a form token right after the redeploy.** The preview was 7 s old and its Lambdas were cold. I typed the first signup over about 4.5 s of page load plus about 3 s of typing, and the form-token response had evidently not landed when Continue was pressed. Three later fresh loads and every other signup this run carried the token. This is the PR's designed fallback: submit never waits on the fetch, and `signup_token_missing` is record-only, so it never shadows a user. On a stage with checks on, cold starts will still log a few `signup_token_missing` signals, so don't treat that signal as a strong bot indicator. - **Guide navigation is still outdated:** the Shadow tier control is only in Admin -> Users -> view mode **Full** -> Admin Actions. The row's Admin button opens the profile page. - **Guide step 11 wording:** since main's #5920, admin settings save through a page-level save bar, not a per-setting Save. - Carried over from R0: the daily-cap message prices at the requested model (a known limit in the PR), cap changes take up to 5 minutes (settings cache), and a request with no `throttleReason` key returns the "outdated version of the app" message.
Cleanup / environment left in this state - Users created: `qa-pr5839-r1s1-e2e` (tier `none`, two audit rows), `qa-pr5839-r1s3-e2e` (credits 10 -> restored to 10,000), `qa-pr5839-r1reg-e2e`. Probe emails `qa-pr5839-probe{0,1,2}-e2e@test.com` never sent a code (`otc/send` was aborted client-side), so no accounts exist for them. - `shadowTierDailyTokenCap` 1000 -> **restored to 20000**. - No Shadow tier left set on any account I touched.
